out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed water packs stored directly on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM relocated water packs on a shelf

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: 3 Compartment Sink Required
violations.observation: There is no operational 3-compartment sink located in the establishment. The required three-compartment sink was not operational and therefore unavailable for proper wash, rinse, sanitize procedures. Instead, the facility was observed using two prep sinks to wash, rinse, and sanitize utensils/equipment.
violations.corrective_action: A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. The facility will repair and maintain the 3-compartment sink in proper condition and use it exclusively for manual warewashing (wash, rinse, sanitize) as required.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: Observed raw chiken stored on top of veal in the 2- door UR Freezer
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CFM relocated veal to the top shelf .

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: 3 Compartment Sink Required
violations.observation: There is no 3-compartment sink located in the establishment. Observed 3-compartment sink not in use.
violations.corrective_action: A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. CFM will repair 3-compartment sink as soon as possible. Cease using the prep sink for washing dishes immediately. In the meantime, disposable utensils should be used.
